differences.justification: Core langchain4j type intentionally exposed by defaultRequestParameters() and the defaultRequestParameters(ChatRequestParameters) builder method, consistent with the other chat model implementations

Removed from the internal wire DTOs; the snake_case naming strategy now lives on the codec, which is what allows the JSON library to be swapped - @JsonNaming is in Jackson 2's databind package and is ignored rather than honoured under Jackson 3. Wire format is unchanged and pinned by AnthropicWireFormatTest.
